name: ai-face
title: A talking AI assistant face made of light
titleKo: 빛의 점으로 만든 말하는 AI 비서 얼굴
about: A human head drawn as a cloud of glowing points that blinks, looks around and moves its lips to what it says. The mouth follows visemes (the shapes lips make for each sound) on a CC0 head model. Here it talks by itself without a voice server: each line turns into visemes from its letters and shows as a caption. Adapted from ptakaya's Claude Face (CC0), as the face of a shop assistant.
aboutKo: 빛나는 점 구름으로 그린 사람 얼굴이 눈을 깜빡이고, 두리번거리고, 말하는 대로 입술을 움직여요. 입 모양은 CC0 머리 모델의 비즘(소리마다 입술이 만드는 모양)을 따라가요. 여기서는 음성 서버 없이 혼자 말해요. 문장 글자로 비즘을 만들고 자막으로 보여 줘요. ptakaya 의 Claude Face(CC0)를 가게 상담 비서 얼굴로 옮겼어요.
prompt: Give my shop's AI assistant a face: a human head made of glowing particles that blinks, looks around and moves its lips while it talks, with what it says as a caption underneath, and let me drag to turn it.
promptKo: 우리 가게 AI 비서에게 얼굴을 만들어 줘. 빛나는 입자로 된 사람 얼굴이 눈을 깜빡이고 두리번거리고, 말할 때 입술이 움직이고, 아래에 하는 말이 자막으로 나오고, 마우스로 끌어서 돌려 볼 수 있게 해 줘.

sources.name: Claude Face by ptakaya (ptakaya/claude-face), an unofficial community project
sources.what: phase1/index.html and phase1/main.js: the particle sampling, viseme mouth, eyes, blinks, look panel and app chrome, kept as written

sources.name: head-default.glb from Claude Face (MakeHuman base body + MPFB eyes, teeth and tongue)
sources.what: assets/head.glb, with its three textures taken out because the particles never read them

sources.name: three.js (GLTFLoader, OrbitControls)
sources.what: the renderer and addons, from the kit

replaces: No voice engine (HeadTTS), no bridge and no Claude session: the page talks silently from its own letter-to-viseme reading and shows each line as a caption. The voice and bridge code is still there and starts only with its URL parameters (?ttsPort=, ?bridge=1). The head's unused textures were removed (5 MB to 1.9 MB).
